Resolves #7224

Add the practical `UsingStores.md` companion to Tables (Stores): a Model/Store subclass with stable keys, a complete shared Grid/ComboBox view, local-to-JSON loading, record edits and structural mutations, and an application-owned projection. Register the page in Data Handling and the SEO priority input, with a link from the conceptual guide.

Evidence: L3 (literal examples executed in Chrome and the actual Portal route rendered) → L3 required for the examples/rendering claims. No acceptance residuals. The guide does not claim packaged-workspace or cross-browser certification.

| AC-2 | All six outline topics are covered: Store/Model role, subclass/key/local data, URL/JSON, Grid binding, independent queries, and get/add/remove/recordChange. Current-source differences are below. |

## Deltas from ticket

The earlier Tables guide already supplies the conceptual introduction. This companion links it and retains the original practical/path criteria. It uses public `url`/`autoLoad` and first binds the same Store to Grid and ComboBox, since ComboBox already owns its private filtering view. An explicit `sourceId` Store teaches an application query rather than an obsolete typing workaround. Model classes are reused through separate instances.

Literal validation found that `data: []` suppresses construction-time autoLoad by marking an empty population loaded. The remote descriptor uses `data: null`; the deliberately invoked manual load remains explicit. The guide also distinguishes shared record values from automatic repaint/notification forwarding.

## Test Evidence

[Exact-guide verification and retained negative control](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/7224#issuecomment-6683316928) record the literal execution; the [initial native proof](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/7224#issuecomment-6682818163) covers field teardown. Source-mode Chrome/Neural Link validation passed three cases: local three-row shared views; remote 59-row loading plus literal operations; and the actual Portal page. A final prose-only Portal check passed, with identical executable-fence hashes.

Observed projection counts were `5 → 4 → 5` around explicit refresh. Standalone Store/Model disposal was checked through both destruction state and registry lookup. Grid repaint and the still-open picker's stale label were observed separately, before structural mutations could mask that distinction. The Portal diagram rendered unscaled at 552 × 520, and prose/code/navigation were visually inspected without overflow.

The final guide hash is `679a0d0f70b4ca4db23c5565da2c897c6f3ace691fc9694443f697d2bc317ac1`. No new unit tests are needed for this documentation-only change. `agent-preflight`, `ai:lint-tree-json` and `ai:lint-guides` are not hosted in Engine; repository link/parse/style guards and explicit route/parent/priority/unique-ID checks ran instead.

Change class: zero-delta (documentation and navigation/SEO inputs).
